name: a bus stop at the curb seen flat from the side: a pale mint sky with a drifting cloud, two rows of soft far hills and a round tree, a grey pavement with a curb line, a metal bench with a slatted seat on two end frames, and a bus-stop sign on a pole cut by the frame; no walls, no people except one seated leg
fits: anything about sitting, waiting or being still for a long time and what it does to the body: legs that go numb, pins and needles, a stiff back, pressure on a nerve; the hero is the leg of someone sitting on the bench with a window on the thigh, the camera dives into the window and back out
recipe: flat 2D side view (no iso), one scale of 12 px a cm: a sky rect that bleeds past the frame, far hills as two soft crest paths, a tree whose crown has a shade half, a pavement slab with a curb edge, a grey metal bench (plank, two end frames), a sign on a pole as a white disc with a small bus; the leg is a thigh rect with a round knee, a shin that tapers to the ankle and a foot with toes, in two skin tones, a rounded oval window with a lip of skin showing a bone, a red vessel with blood cells and a cream-yellow nerve with signal dots
